runner: function extract(ff,names){let rows=[];for(let f of ff){for(let m of f.content.matchAll(/\[\s*(SPECIES_[A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{/g)){if(!names.includes(m[1].slice(8)))continue;let start=m.index+m[0].length,d=1,j=start;for(;j<f.content.length&&d;j++){if(f.content[j]==="{")d++;if(f.content[j]==="}")d--}let b=f.content.slice(start,j-1),ev=b.indexOf(".evolutions");if(ev<0)continue;let k=b.indexOf("EVOLUTION(",ev);if(k<0)continue;let p=k+10,dep=1;for(;p<b.length&&dep;p++){if(b[p]==="(")dep++;if(b[p]===")")dep--}rows.push({parent:m[1],path:f.path,blob:f.sha,raw:b.slice(k,p),line:f.content.slice(0,m.index).split("\n").length})}}return rows}
